author: Dave Fallon
text: Blake is an absolute professional! He is very knowledgeable and skilled at a difficult job. I asked many questions which he was able to provide excellent answers for. I look forward to working with again to upgrade my facility.

author: Steven Petrie
text: Highly recommend Tank It Easy for your septic system needs. Blake was professional, polite, and honest. Given this small, locally owned, business a try next time you need septic services.

author: Bobbi Harlan
text: Blake and Sutherland are awesome! Super easy to work with, great communication, friendly & happy to help. Scheduling was easy, they send reminders & updates on ETA ; Blake arrived on time, did an excellent job, answered questions, and left us very happy that we had chosen Tank it Easy. Highly recommend!

author: Shayna Tisdall
text: FANTASTIC! Great customer service! Polite! Hardworking! They came out right away, diagnosed the problem and went above and beyond to pump our tanks to ensure we wouldn’t have issues until they could come back the following day to replace our pump. 100% recommend!

author: Kathie P
text: Blake corrected a problem with our septic float system.  Once again, on time, completed quickly, very fair pricing and explained what was needed and why. Highly recommend based on quality of service and how easy it is to work with Blake and Sutherlan! Thank you!
